summary: Forest Service tower at the Oak Grove Ranger Station, built 1930 and listed as gone or removed. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as removed; the sources give no removal date

events.note: USFS constructed a tower at the ranger station compound

evidence.supports: 1930 tower built by USFS at the ranger station compound
evidence.quote: In 1930 the USFS constructed a tower at the ranger station compound.

evidence.supports: administered by the U.S. Forest Service

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 2,000 ft (610 m) and firelookout.com gives 1,920 ft. The record keeps the register figure and the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: three short listings, no staffing, no fire history, no present-day description. The story is about 90 words, under the 120-word floor, because the sources give nothing more; editor to decide whether to keep it short. The geocache and Oregon Historic Sites pages returned only a title or a redirect from the cache, so they are not cited. Brief's build year (1930), status (gone) and coordinates agree with the sources. The brief's elevation_m of 609.6 matches the register figure only.
